description: The Search manage REST API states a 7.0.2 exception for disableFileTransferRebalance not previously captured anywhere in the corpus: file-transfer rebalance 'requires all Search Service nodes either to be running 7.1 or later; or to be running 7.0.2, with the feature explicitly switched on by means of this endpoint' - meaning on 7.0.2 specifically the behavior is opt-in via this same PUT /api/managerOptions call, rather than the 7.1+ default-on behavior. Round 23's disableFileTransferRebalance record never quoted this version nuance since its source page didn't state it.
